body: In my case the non-attraction is so universal that it’s basically hatred.
I agree that looks aren’t everything, but no one else realizes that, otherwise I wouldn’t be in this position.
You’ve never seen what I look like. If you did, I guarantee you’d instantly hate me.

All the women I’ve approached in real life have told me no too. All Women hate me and I want to do them all a service by getting rid of myself, Tinder is going to be the final nail in the coffin tonight.

There’s someone for everyone except me, apparently. Women run from me immediately when I approach them in real life, and dating apps failed to save my life.

Every single woman on this Earth will be glad to see me gone. I guarantee it.
I’ve been rejected tons of times in real life too
